description: The REVTeX source, figures and compiled PDF of the paper Dense Algebraic Loci of Hodge Classes, the Lean 4 certificate lean/HodgeClosure.lean (fifty-nine theorems: forty-nine axiom-free, two on propext and Quot.sound, eight on propext), and the Python, Julia, C, C++ and shell programs that recompute every finite quantity used in the proofs (code/run_all.sh). The paper proves that the Hodge conjecture is equivalent to two statements about abelian varieties, that for each the known locus is dense and either everything or meagre, proves the real multiplications by sqrt 5, sqrt 6, sqrt 7 and by the cubic fields Q(zeta_7)^+ and Q(zeta_9)^+ algebraic on explicit families of K3 surfaces, builds the first object each statement needs, and at the point of complex multiplication E_0^6 bounds dim Ext^2 by isolated Ext blocks for every twisting cochain, which settles every placement of thirty-five pieces, shows that one threefold piece outside every closed chain of Ext blocks fails the criterion, which settles every further piece of positive twist within one shift of the thirty-two threefolds, proves for every polarisation of E_0^6 that a convolution of distinct threefolds and at most five line bundles at any twists fails the criterion, enumerates the arrangements of six, seven and eight line bundles (six and seven fail, eight outside thirty-one arrangements), and reads the support of an object meeting the criterion off the obstruction class localised to that support: the rest of the support cuts a threefold of nonzero multiplicity in an ample divisor, two threefolds meeting along a surface carry nothing between them, no object supported on the thirty-two threefolds of one family has the polarised shape, and a smooth complete intersection meeting the threefolds in curves cannot carry the rest; what remains at that point are eight or more line bundles, with or without threefolds, and the supports mixing the two families of threefolds, decided by the products along their chains. The candidate configurations were proposed by the Anaxia engine of the BLLM project (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23469389), the support results by its release 3.1.0 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23484160), and all are decided by the proofs and the programs. Neither statement is proved and the conjecture is not claimed. The folder preprints holds the compiled paper only.
